title: Retirement contributions withheld versus remitted to the plan
prompt: Reconcile employee and employer retirement contributions withheld through payroll to amounts remitted to the plan. Flag missed or duplicate deductions.
keywords: last pay date (period rule stand-in: business_day)
comment: Trigger period rule: the library has no last_pay_date rule yet, so business_day stands in; the pay period itself comes from the payCalendar setup answer and the register dates. Runs on the payroll.pay_run event or on request.

setup.q: Who is the retirement plan provider or recordkeeper?
What is the employer match formula (for example 100% of the first 3% and 50% of the next 2%)?
Which ledger account holds retirement contributions payable?

inputs.name: Payroll deduction export for the pay period (employee and employer retirement lines)
Plan remittance report for the same pay period

steps: run column_map over the deduction export and the remittance report (headers never positions) and save the mapping to data/deduction-columns.json
total employee deferrals and employer match from the deduction export; recompute the match per employee id from the match formula and list rows where the paid match differs
run duplicate_pairs over the deduction rows (same employee id, same amount, same pay date) for duplicate deductions; list eligible employees with no deduction in the period as missed
tie withheld totals to remitted totals per contribution type; pull the liability account ledger and tie the remittance to its posting
write the workbook with employee ids only, totals on the Tie-out, no names or pay

done.text: The deduction export and remittance report columns were mapped by header with no ambiguous or missing required column
Every exception row cites the employee id and the payroll line or remittance line
retirement-remittance-reconciliation.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
The deliverable describes deductions and remittances, never people's conduct
Missed and duplicate deductions are listed by employee id with the pay date and amount; the employer match is recomputed from the stated formula and differences shown with both figures
No employee name or pay figure appears in the deliverable; the Tie-out carries totals by contribution type only
